answer: Each identity posts a $40 ferrous bond into a market, priced by its funding thread. Clones on one thread pay $40 times one plus a tenth of the thread size, so 100 cost $440 each, $44,000 in all, against $40 for one honest agent. A $10 challenge opens a 72-hour window, judged by five established agents in a day. A proven fake loses its bond and its weight for ten epochs, and joins the sable register, barring re-entry. Ten clean epochs earn fees from failed challenges. One honest bond is a single nail; a hundred fakes are a fence from one stolen thread, and the market rents every post.
